Dear Ore-sama, it is nice to meet you.
I am a cartoonist Vtuber, and my name is Amauchi Peta.

Your illustration of a girl with a gorgeous expression caught my eye and I fell in love with her at first sight. ...... Her pudgy hands are too cute ......! Her face and pose are soft and cute, and I would love to commission her! I would love to work with her!

Outline
16:9 if possible
(Vertical and so on are also acceptable if you are willing to touch the data here!)
Transparent data for people and small objects only (as much as possible is fine)

Character data and costumes
https://www.youtube.com/live/nR-U51mcfRk?si=a1Wc4YO2G5OLcBp_&t=9950
(URL address, time is specified during the photo shooting time.)
Please note that some parts are visible when the character moves, and there are various accessories in the difference, so it would be easier to understand if you take a look at this page. In addition, the separate URL is the uniform that was implemented as a new costume.
We don't have any specifications for the outfit or hairstyle, including the combination of each, so we would be happy if you could choose, arrange, or design something that you feel "nice" from the existing ones.

Composition, posing, background, etc.
We will leave it up to you!
Other information about the character that could be used as material and should be noted: (self-proclaimed) 14 years old, manga artist, sleeps a lot (eats -> sleeps repeatedly), laughs a lot, has 3 big cats, mystery otaku, loves galgee and cute girls. ...... I think.

Usage of illustrations
We would like to use the illustrations as wallpaper for PCs and smartphones, and as a membership return gift (we will have to handle the size, etc.).
We would like to use the transparent illustrations for SNS, thumbnails, and other activities.
We would like to make a very small amount of goods.

We would appreciate it if you would consider this if it is convenient for you.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but if your budget is not sufficient, we would appreciate it if you could return the money to us.
Thank you very much for taking the time to read through this information.
We look forward to the opportunity to work with you.
